implementation: Faithful SHA256 53-bit draw at offset 8 from engine/rust/question_selection.rs::select; all delivered questions are moderate, so every positive moderate weight renormalizes onto this band.
seen_history_scenario: Remove first provisional entity; 64 draws never select it. Seen-before-task plus current prefix only remove questions.
limitation: No live learner history, policy, or new entity IDs supplied. The unconfigured fallback chooses lowest fresh entity; a configured positive moderate weight samples uniformly within fresh moderate candidates. Does not assert live configured weights or a particular learner trajectory.
